metadata.question: Did the area around Walvis Bay, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about NDVI comparison between February 2021 and the 2010-2020 average for February around Walvis Bay, Namibia. Strategy: 1. Location: Walvis Bay, Namibia (coordinates approximately -22.9576, 14.5053) 2. Time periods: February 2021 vs February 2010-2020 average 3. Data: Use Sentinel-2 for NDVI calculation (best for recent years) 4. Processing: Calculate NDVI, mask clouds, compare values Important considerations: - Need to handle potential missing data (especially for older years) - Need to validate pixel counts after cloud masking - Compare single year (2021) against multi-year average (2010-2020) Steps: 1. Define geometry around Walvis Bay 2. Get Sentinel-2 collections for both time periods 3. Calculate NDVI and mask clouds 4. Compute mean NDVI values 5. Compare and provide answer Fallback strategy: If Sentinel-2 has no data for older years, I might need to use Landsat, but let's try Sentinel-2 first since it has better resolution. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const walvisBay = ee.Geometry.Point([14.5053, -22.9576]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Walvis Bay const feb2021 = ['2021-02-01', '2021-02-28']; const febHistorical = ['2010-02-01', '2020-02-28']; // All Februarys from 2010-2020 // Function to calculate NDVI and mask clouds function processS2(image) { // Cloud masking const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); // Calculate NDVI const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi).updateMask(mask); } // 2. Data Acquisition for 2021 let col2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(walvisBay) .filterDate(feb2021[0], feb2021[1]) .map(processS2) .select('NDVI'); // 3. Data Acquisition for historical period let colHistorical = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(walvisBay) .filterDate(febHistorical[0], febHistorical[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')) // Only February months .map(processS2) .select('NDVI'); // Check collection sizes const size2021 = col2021.size().getInfo(); const sizeHistorical = colHistorical.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2021 Images: ${size2021}`); console.log(`Historical Images (2010-2020 Feb): ${sizeHistorical}`); // Handle empty collections if (size2021 === 0 || sizeHistorical === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate mean NDVI for 2021 const mean2021 = col2021.mean(); const stats2021 = mean2021.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: walvisBay, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); // Calculate mean NDVI for historical period const meanHistorical = colHistorical.mean(); const statsHistorical = meanHistorical.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: walvisBay, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndvi2021 = stats2021.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const count2021 = stats2021.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); const ndviHistorical = statsHistorical.get('NDVI_mean').getInfo(); const countHistorical = statsHistorical.get('NDVI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2021 NDVI: ${ndvi2021?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${count2021}`); console.log(`Historical NDVI: ${ndviHistorical?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${countHistorical}`); // Check for valid pixels if (count2021 === 0 || countHistorical === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (ndvi2021 === null || ndviHistorical === null || isNaN(ndvi2021) || isNaN(ndviHistorical) || ndvi2021 > 1 || ndvi2021 < -1 || ndviHistorical > 1 || ndviHistorical < -1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare and output result if (ndvi2021 > ndviHistorical) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
